entries.german: Ks Karl IV. bekundet: Er hat alle Streitigkeiten (omnem controversiam seu dissensionem ac displicenciarum materiam), die vormals zwischen ihm [dem Ks.] einerseits, und dem Peter, Propst der Allerheiligenkapelle in der Burg zu Prag sowie den Edlen Jodocus, Ulrich und Jesko Gebr. von Rosenberg samt ihren Freunden, Dienern, Helfern und Hintersassen andererseits bestanden hatten, gnädigerweise zurückgestellt (benigne remisimus) und diesen, da sie ihn demütig und inständig darum baten (nobis super hoc humiliter et cum instancia supplicantibus), den Weg der Güte gewiesen (veniam pie indulsimus ac presentibus indulgemus), indem er alle Ausschreitungen und Schädigungen, die durch sie und ihre Hintersassen ihm oder anderen gegenüber an Leib und Gut geschehen sind, vergibt (universos excessus, iniurias, molestias sive dampna, per eos et eorum quoslibet subditis nostris sive nobilibus sive aliis quibuscunque in personis, possessionibus, bonis et rebus mobilibus aut immobilibus tempore huiusmodi displicenciarum illatos, illatas sive illata, tollimus, abolimus et tenore presencium ex certa sciencia relaxamus). Er will zugleich und setzt kraft kgl. böhmischer Gewalt fest (volentes et auctoritate regia Boemie decernentes), daß die gen. Brüder von Rosenberg samt ihren Freunden, Dienern, Helfern und Hintersassen von allen diesen Übergriffen und Schädigungen befreit sein sollen und dafür nirgendwo an den im einzelnen genannten Land- und Stadtgerichten beklagt, deswegen vorgeladen oder verurteilt werden können (censeantur et realiter existant immunes nec possint a quocunque super hiis diffamari, accusari seu notari aut ad regale vel zude seu quodcumque aliud provinciale aut municipale iudicium a quocunque zudario, iusticiario vel iudice ad cuiuscunque instanciam evocari, citari, trahi, iudicari aut realiter vel personaliter condempnari nec super premissis per quempiam dictis iudiciis presidentem nunc et imposterum ullus possit vel debeat processus fieri contra eos vel aliquos seu aliquem eorundem). Zugleich verbietet er allen Amtsträgern des Königreiches Böhmen bei Verlust seiner Gnade (sub obtentu gracie nostre districcius inhibemus), in der angegebenen Weise gegen diese Festsetzung (contra presentem remissionem, indultum ac decretum nostre celsitudinis) die von Rosenberg, deren Freunde, Diener, Helfer oder Untertanen aufgrund ihrer Ausschreitungen vorzuladen oder zu verurteilen (ad iudicia sua pretextu excessuum, iniuriarum, molestiarium atque dampnorum cuicumque sepedictarum dissensionum tempore, sicut premittitur, illatorum, citare, vocare, trahere vel contra ipsos procedere, iudicare, condempnare, sentencias ferre aut quidquam in ipsorum preiudicium audeant attemptare).
entries.english:
Emperor Karl IV attests: He has graciously set aside every dispute, disagreement, and cause of displeasure that formerly existed between himself on the one hand and Peter, provost of the All Saints’ Chapel in Prague Castle, and the nobles Jodocus, Ulrich, and Jesko, brothers von Rosenberg, together with their friends, servants, helpers, and dependants, on the other. Since they humbly and earnestly petitioned him about this, he has mercifully granted them pardon and hereby grants it, forgiving all excesses, injuries, grievances, and damage inflicted by them or any of their dependants on him or on others, whether nobles or anyone else, to persons, possessions, property, or movable or immovable goods during the period of these disputes.

He also wills and decrees by royal authority in Bohemia that the aforesaid brothers von Rosenberg, together with their friends, servants, helpers, and dependants, are to be free from all these transgressions and injuries. No one may accuse or denounce them on this account, or at anyone’s request summon, cite, bring before, judge, or condemn them in person or in property before any of the specified royal, urban, provincial, or municipal courts. No proceedings may now or henceforth be brought against them, or any of them, by anyone presiding over those courts in respect of the foregoing.

He strictly forbids all officials of the Kingdom of Bohemia, under threat of losing his favour, to summon, call, bring before their courts, proceed against, judge, condemn, pass sentence on, or otherwise prejudice the von Rosenbergs, their friends, servants, helpers, or subjects in respect of the excesses, injuries, grievances, and damages inflicted during the aforesaid disputes, contrary to this remission, pardon, and decree of his majesty.
